payout_quote: 3.50% APY — Online Savings Account Annual Percentage Yield. 'Annual Percentage Yield as of September 22, 2026. APY may change at any time before or after account is opened. Maximum balance limits apply.' No fees. No minimum deposit. FDIC-insured: Goldman Sachs Bank USA, Salt Lake City Branch. This is interest on your own deposits, not a signup bonus.
timing: No signup bonus exists. Interest accrues on the balance; transfers of $100,000 or less to/from other banks are processed same-day (by 5pm ET if requested by 12pm ET on a business day).
eligibility: 18+, US resident. No minimum deposit to open; maximum balance limits apply. Identity verification required.
biggest_catch: There is no signup bonus — Marcus pays interest only, so you earn nothing without parking your own money, and the 3.50% APY is variable and can change at any time before or after the account is opened.
catches: No signup bonus exists on marcus.com — the only 'payout' is variable interest on your own deposits.
APY may change at any time before or after the account is opened.
Maximum balance limits apply (caps not enumerated on the landing page).
Maximum of six (6) withdrawals or transfers per monthly statement period.
steps: Go to https://www.marcus.com/us/en/savings/high-yield-savings and click Open an account.
Complete the application and identity verification.
Link your external bank account (schedule one-time or recurring transfers).
Fund the account — no minimum deposit required.
Keep funds parked to earn the variable 3.50% APY (as of 09/22/2026); transfers of $100,000 or less move same-day.
